name: Thousand Arrows
description: You summon forth a volley of green arrows to pierce creatures in range. All creatures in a {shape}, centered on a point within range, must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a hit, or half as much on a save. Flying-type creatures or ones with Levitate, Magnet Rise, or similar ability CAN be hit by this move. Any creature that fails the saving throw falls to the ground and is now grounded. Grounded creatures are susceptible to to ground-type moves until they raise up, regardless of their type or ability.
